evidence.evidence_text: We introduce an explainable complaint dataset, X-CI, the first benchmark dataset for explainable complaint detection.

Each instance in the X-CI dataset is annotated with five labels: complaint label, emotion label, polarity label, complaint severity level, and rationale (explainability), i.e., the causal span explaining the reason for the complaint/non-complaint label.
